notes.description: Every note on the page, oldest first: {notes: [{id, anchor, quote, text, author, agent, role, reply_to, at, resolved}]}. `anchor` is the paragraph's data-a id; a reply has `reply_to`, its thread's first note, which alone says whether the thread is `resolved`. `author` is who wrote it (an agent acting for someone: them, with the agent in `agent`); `role` theirs on the page then; `at` epoch ms.

annotate.description: Leave a note on the paragraph whose data-a id is `anchor`, optionally quoting the words it is about (`quote`), or reply to a thread with `reply_to` (any of its notes' ids; a reply to a resolved thread reopens it). Signed-in people and agents only: an anonymous visitor is refused. Answers {id, thread}.

resolve.description: Resolve the thread a note is in (`resolved: true`), or reopen it (`false`). Only the thread's author or the page's owner. Answers {id, resolved}, `id` the thread's first note.

remove_note.description: Delete a note for good; a thread's first note takes its replies with it. Only the note's author or the page's owner. Answers {removed}, how many notes went (0: it was gone already).

meta.title: Doc
meta.description: A page of writing its readers leave notes on, paragraph by paragraph: in the margin, live.
